issues.on_page: Lines 44-48 printed under the heading 'Business-Type Activities:' (paid from the General Fund column)
issues.issue: Exhibit A itself classifies these utility lines as business-type activities, but they are recorded as governmental (the utility receipts are presumably inside General Fund 'Local Receipts: Other' and can't be separated). This is a judgment call that changes the governmental totals by 41,231.22. It is missing from decision_needed. The same applies to disbursements[4] and [5].

38% of receipts are in 'other'. The General Fund portion (41,631.02) is about the same as the utility spending paid from that fund (41,231.22), so it is most likely utility charges for services. The filing does not say, so 'other' with review is defensible.
A TIF fund expense could be economic development rather than 'other'. Immaterial.
